effect: Tax bases change smoothly with GDP per head instead of jumping at 3k, 10k and 25k $. Each tiered share of the tax-base function (labour, formal labour, consumption, profits, financial turnover, the energy fallback, carbon, accounting unit) is the original tier value at the country's day-0 GDP per head (demo.gdpCap0) plus the change of a smooth curve (piecewise linear in log GDP per head through the tier centres 1.5k, 5.5k, 15.8k and 50k) since then. A country crossing a tier boundary no longer gains or loses a slice of revenue overnight. Since build 26311815 property tax is a household wealth tax with no GDP-per-head tier, so it is not smoothed here. Since build 26346311 the financial-turnover tiers are the game's rebalanced .011 below 25k and .025 from 25k (were .08 and .18); the smoothing follows them. Day 0 exact: at day-0 GDP per head every share equals its original tier value (no recalibration needed); without demo data the original steps apply. (Minified names in this text are those of build 26296134; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
